summary: myseliasan now implements apphost's ReadinessReporter interface, surfacing fleet-listener health as advisory fields on GET /api/ready: controlChannel (up/down, whether the parent<->node control-channel listener's serve loop is active), connectedNodes (count of nodes currently holding a live control connection), and mediaRelay (up/down, whether the node-camera media relay listener is active). ControlServer gained IsListening() (atomic bool set around its serve loop) and ConnectedCount(); the app module is now stateful, holding the *ControlServer and an atomic media-listening flag set during RegisterAppRoutes, with a new ReadinessStatus method feeding them into the shared /ready handler. This closes the gap where a dead control-channel or media listener still reported the process fully ready.
compatibility: Advisory only, per the existing apphost.ReadinessReporter contract: these fields never flip the process's ok/HTTP status on /ready or /api/ready, which stays gated on db + cache exactly as before. Existing installs see no behavior change other than three new string/number fields appearing in the /api/ready JSON payload once the fleet listeners have started; nothing consumes or requires them yet. Actually gating readiness on the fleet listeners (i.e. failing /ready when they are down) would be a separate, core-scoped apphost contract change affecting every app and was deliberately not done here.
